title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The life-saving multi-sectoral assistance to conflict and natural disaster-affected people in Banadir and Lower Shabelle, Somalia implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to improve the resilience of chronically-affected populations through enhanced access to high-quality nutrition, health, education; and improved emergency preparedness. The objectives of the programme is to ensure IDPs and vulnerable host households affected by natural disaster and conflict have access to basic needs including food and non-food items; to increase equitable access to quality education in a protective environment for children; to improve access to quality essential primary health and nutrition services; and to work with local NGO partners to enhance preparedness and responses to natural disasters and conflicts. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Improved child and maternal health and nutritional status by increasing access to essential integrated health, nutrition services and promoting sustainable behaviour change.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Training sessions on emergency response and preparedness aim to provide participants with a thorough understanding of the core principles and frameworks that underpin effective emergency preparedness in diverse humanitarian contexts. The session emphasized the importance of readiness in responding to various types of emergencies, such as natural disasters, conflict-induced crises, and public health emergencies.
